name: Visual balance
definition: The visual weights on the two sides of a centre cancel out. Formal balance uses mirrored equal weights; informal balance sets a large near mass against several small far masses.

measures.measure: moment of visual weight, left to right about the centre

sources.title: Rudolf Arnheim, Art and Visual Perception: A Psychology of the Creative Eye (University of California Press, 1954; new version 1974)
Donis A. Dondis, A Primer of Visual Literacy (MIT Press, 1973)
